questions.q: Two similar triangles have corresponding sides 4 cm and 10 cm. The smaller has area 12 cm². Find the area of the larger.
questions.why: Length factor 2.5, so area factor 2.5² = 6.25 and 12 × 6.25 = 75 cm².

questions.q: Two similar bottles have heights 10 cm and 20 cm. The smaller holds 300 cm³. How much does the larger hold?
questions.why: Length factor 2, so volume factor 2³ = 8 and 300 × 8 = 2400 cm³.

questions.q: A map has scale 1 : 25 000. What real distance is 4 cm on the map?
Two similar solids have surface areas 18 cm² and 50 cm². Find the ratio of their volumes.
questions.model: Area ratio 9 : 25, so length ratio 3 : 5, so volume ratio 27 : 125
